submitted_text: David Kim, policy POL-11220. We've been out of the country since early May and just got back on 2026-07-08 to find the back door forced open and the TV, a laptop, and some jewelry gone. House had been sitting empty the whole time we were away, about ten weeks. Estimated loss around $9,000.
